scope: Fix a real, pre-existing global CORS bug found live via deployment log inspection: OPTIONS preflight always returns 200 but never sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin for non-allowlisted origins, silently blocking every content-script request from any third-party host page.

steps.title: Fix global CORS middleware -- OPTIONS preflight was returning 200 without Access-Control-Allow-Origin for any non-allowlisted origin, silently blocking every extension content-script request
steps.task: Add a special case for /api/v1/extension/ paths so cross-origin content-script requests from arbitrary host pages get Access-Control-Allow-Origin set, using PATCH MODE.
non_goals: a full-file rewrite -- use patch mode only
loosening CORS for any non-extension route
